root_idea.summary: The root has two principal semantic orientations: seeking or pursuing something, and a form of corruption expressed as exceeding proper bounds.
root_idea.development: The seeking branch extends to purposeful or earnest pursuit and to seeking something on behalf of another. The second branch develops into envy, wrongful excess, oppression, and related specialized uses; the Form VII construction develops the sense of being suitable, possible, or proper.

senses.definition: To seek, pursue, desire, or endeavor to obtain something.
senses.usage_conditions: The object may be something good or harmful. The verb may also express seeking or desiring a result, way, or object.

senses.definition: To seek something for another person, or to assist another person in seeking it.
senses.usage_conditions: The construction may use a benefactive complement, including the sense “seek for someone” or “help someone seek.”

senses.definition: To exceed the proper bounds and thereby act wrongfully, oppressively, or rebelliously toward another.
senses.usage_conditions: The construction commonly takes عَلَى with the person or group wronged; passive usage expresses being subjected to such wrong.

senses.definition: To speak falsely, in the reported Quranic interpretation “we do not lie.”
senses.usage_conditions: This interpretation is specifically reported for the expression مَا نَبْغِي in 12:65; the same expression is also understood as “what do we seek?”

senses.definition: To be suitable, fitting, proper, appropriate, allowable, or incumbent.
senses.usage_conditions: Usually occurs in the impersonal construction يَنْبَغِي لِـ or يَنْبَغِي أَنْ, expressing what is proper or behooving for someone or something.

senses.definition: To be facilitated, possible, practicable, or manageable.
senses.usage_conditions: This sense emphasizes whether an action can readily occur or be carried out, rather than merely whether it is normatively proper.

senses.definition: To seek, pursue, or aim at something with earnest or deliberate effort.
senses.usage_conditions: Form VIII characteristically emphasizes purposeful exertion in seeking; the object may be a material benefit, a way, a divine favor, or another desired end.

senses.definition: One who seeks what is not permitted or exceeds the necessary limit.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic dietary exception, it describes neither seeking the forbidden food for appetite or pleasure nor exceeding the amount needed to relieve hunger; it may also be understood as not acting rebelliously or wrongfully.

senses.definition: A sexually unchaste woman; a fornicatress or prostitute.
senses.usage_conditions: The lexical term is explicitly feminine in the supplied evidence and is not applied to a man.

senses.definition: Envy: a rancorous wish that another’s blessing, happiness, or excellence should pass to oneself.
senses.usage_conditions: This sense describes the motive or disposition of resenting another’s favor, rather than the overt act of oppression itself.

senses.definition: Wrongful transgression, oppression, tyranny, or rebellion; exceeding the bounds of right.
senses.usage_conditions: The noun may describe injustice toward people, rebellion against rightful authority, or corrupt excess generally.

senses.definition: Fornication or prostitution; the practice of prostituting oneself.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic construction concerns compelling young women to engage in prostitution.

senses.definition: Earnest seeking, pursuit, or aiming at a desired end.
senses.usage_conditions: The verbal noun denotes purposeful seeking and may take a material object, a means, a divine favor, or an intended result.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To love or favor a thing.
To envy another, wishing that the other’s blessing or excellence would transfer to oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the verbal construction underlying the corresponding noun sense of envy.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To procure disease for someone or cause disease to befall someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the construction بَغَانِي دَاءً.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who seeks gain or makes much gain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression is reported with some variation in interpretation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Good was not appointed or destined to befall him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed or specialized passive expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To lie or say what is untrue.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the general verbal meaning, beyond the specifically reported interpretation of مَا نَبْغِي in 12:65.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To look at a thing in order to determine how it is.
To look for, watch, or wait for a person or thing.
To cause or make someone seek, desire, or endeavor to obtain a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction makes another person the seeker of the object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To act wrongfully, oppressively, or tyrannically toward one another; to overpower or oppress one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form VI construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask a group to seek a thing for someone, after which they seek it for him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction expresses requesting or commissioning others to search.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the sky, to rain vehemently or beyond the amount needed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used of rain exceeding the desired or customary limit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a valley, to flow with water beyond a place reached previously.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of water overflowing its former limit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The main portion or vehemence of rain from the sky.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may denote the heavy bulk or force of rainfall.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a wound, to swell, become corrupt, and produce thick purulent matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized medical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To magnify oneself or behave proudly, haughtily, or insolently.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sense is explained as exceeding one’s proper station.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse, to move with proud self-confidence and excessive briskness or liveliness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of a horse’s gait.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing sought, wanted, needed, or required; an object of desire or need.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related forms distinguish, in some accounts, the sought state from the wanted thing itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A female slave, whether or not sexually unchaste; also, by extension, a female singer even if chaste.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The slave and singer usages are historical extensions and are distinct from the Quranic sense of a sexually unchaste woman.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Scouts or companies of scouts preceding an army.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized plural usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A seeker or pursuer, especially one searching for a stray animal or another object.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the broad active-participle meaning apart from the Quranic restriction on seeking beyond what is permitted or needed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel that does not impregnate or become pregnant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A horse that is proud or self-conceited and exceptionally brisk or lively.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized and disputed lexical application to a horse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The game or other object sought by a sportsman or hunter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural form used as a collective designation for quarry.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place, route, or manner in which something is sought.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term can denote the means or proper way of pursuing an object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The lion, as a persistent seeker of prey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or zoological designation based on the animal’s pursuit of prey.

other_classical_meanings.definition: According to one reported usage, knowledge of and acquiescence in a woman’s fornication or prostitution.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The report itself treats this as an amplification in expression rather than the ordinary lexical sense.

cautions: The expression مَا نَبْغِي in 12:65 has competing lexical interpretations in the supplied evidence: “what do we seek?” and “we do not lie”; both are retained under the Form I verb.
One Lane phrase under the Form III entry is retained as ambiguous because the evidence itself assigns it to other possible roots.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: lane-unit:bgy:36824:g2:main reports the phrase إِنَّكِ لَجَمِيلَةٌ وَلَا تُبَاغِى with a proposed interpretation, but the same evidence says that some authorities assign the verb to the roots بوغ or بيغ rather than بغي; it is therefore not assigned to a public meaning.
